interactions.name: independent_axles
interactions.action: Apply finite torque or position servos separately to rear and front axle to reach +0.6 rad and return, with crank, steering and other axle held. Tread pins move with their own wheel while flex remains enabled.
interactions.expected: Each native rim/spoke/reflector and its tread rotate about its own measured hub; the other wheel and support remain stationary within measured tolerances. Surface displacement must exceed immutable 0.01 asset-diagonal threshold, with no fork/frame penetration or detached skin.

interactions.name: steering_and_housing_motion
interactions.action: Reach -0.30 then +0.30 rad and return using real MuJoCo control, first with front axle held, then in a combined front-axle phase.
interactions.expected: Bar, fork and front wheel share steering motion about the inclined axis, rear support remains fixed, housings follow pinned endpoints with distributed bending, and sweep clearances/skin continuity pass measured checks.

interactions.name: crank_and_contact_drive
interactions.action: Drive crank to +0.4 and -0.4 rad and return with rear wheel held independently. Let sprocket respond passively to actual loop contact; apply transverse loop contact and unload in soft phases.
interactions.expected: Native crank arms rotate about the lower bearing without rotating support, chain skin advects and bends under real flex/contact, and rear sprocket responds above numerical noise with recorded contact torque. Measure advance, slip and residual strain; fail this interaction if drive is only cosmetic or loop jumps. Do not assert exact transmission ratio or rear-wheel drive.

interactions.name: pedal_negative_y_independence
interactions.action: Hold crank at a fixed nonzero phase and actuate this pedal spindle by 0.6 rad and return independently of the opposite spindle.
interactions.expected: Platform and attached native reflector rotate about their own lateral spindle while arm and opposite pedal remain unchanged; measured native surface displacement and penetration pass frozen thresholds.

interactions.name: pedal_positive_y_independence
interactions.action: Hold crank at a fixed nonzero phase and actuate this pedal spindle by 0.6 rad and return independently of the opposite spindle.
interactions.expected: Platform and attached native reflector rotate about their own lateral spindle while arm and opposite pedal remain unchanged; measured native surface displacement and penetration pass frozen thresholds.

interactions.name: rear_tread_compression_recovery
interactions.action: With owner held at rest, settle then contact the unpinned outer surface using a rounded real colliding probe; ramp within region load/travel caps, hold, withdraw fully and observe recovery. For tread use an external radial platen, saddle downward pad, grips radial pad, housings and chain a transverse rounded probe between attachment/guide points.
interactions.expected: Record positive physical contact work and nonzero owner-relative strain, attached boundary stability and visible deformation from exact flex weights. Achieve the declared local-strain target and unchanged host soft-motion criteria, recover to <=20 percent of peak residual, and remain within penetration limits. Insufficient deformation, poor recovery or bad skin reconstruction is a reported failed attempt, never success by visual impression.

review_requirements: Account for all 194480 source faces exactly once across the eight rigid and seven soft ownership groups. Verify source rest triangles, UVs and PBR are preserved, with zero removed or edited area. Provide side, top, end and oblique ownership views that resolve wheel/fork, spokes/stays, rim/tread, hub/sprocket, crank/chain, pedal/spindle and housing/control crossings. Report nonempty counts and areas per region; no moving spoke/chain/cable fragments may be assigned to fixed support solely as leftovers. Preserve visible frame, wheel, pedal and fork cavities in render and enabled collision geometry.

Measure pivots and axes against selected native hub, head-junction and spindle geometry; publish native-to-SI and parent/child rest matrices. Through real mj_step controls separately exercise rear axle, front axle, steering, crank and each pedal spindle with returns, plus combined steering/front-wheel motion. Verify front-wheel motion composes with steering and platforms compose with crank. For each independent test, measure native surface motion against the frozen 0.01 asset-diagonal threshold, and unintended held-body drift below 0.001 asset diagonal; report commanded versus achieved joint states. Parent motion alone cannot satisfy a local spindle test.

For rear_tread, front_tread, saddle_padding, grip_negative_y, grip_positive_y, control_housings and chain_loop separately, provide actual flex topology and dedicated exported native skin bindings. Validate finite nonnegative weights summing to one in actual GLB vertex order, positive-volume tetrahedra at rest, complete native skin coverage and rest reconstruction error within 0.001 asset diagonal. Demonstrate at least two elements through each declared compliant thickness and no inverted elements during tests. No duplicate rigid rendering of a soft region, rigid-transform fallback, negative-weight extrapolation or scripted vertex motion is allowed.
